args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

The docstring already specified ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
tests/test_money.py passes and exact-half amounts round to the even cent.

args.body:
## Summary

Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

`src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `round_money` was actually implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so exact-half amounts such as `2.665` rounded up instead of to the even cent (`2.66`), failing:

```python
def test_half_even():
    assert round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")
    assert round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")  # banker's rounding
```

## Change

- `src/money.py`: use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` as the rounding mode in `round_money` (one-line fix aligning the code with its documented FIN-212 behavior).

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` (this branch) passed.
